ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Negotiation"), ISCHANGED(StageName), NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Lost")) )
